candidates.description: Can use up to 3 drones that do not block (max 3 deployed at once). Drones' effect changes based upon Skill.

levels.name: High-Efficiency Freezing Module
levels.description:
Passive: <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> enemies within the Attack Range of this unit and drones every <@ba.vup>{attack@interval}</> seconds for <@ba.vup>{attack@sluggish}</> seconds
Active: Instead of <$ba.sluggish>Slowing</>, <$ba.root>Binds</> targets for <@ba.vup>{attack@frozen_duration}</> seconds. <@ba.rem>Retreats all drones after this effect ends</>

levels.name: Laser Mining Module
levels.description:
Passive: Drones may be deployed on melee tiles, dealing single-target Arts damage. 
Active: Magallan and her drones gain <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</> ASPD, and drones gain <@ba.vup>AoE</> attacks. <@ba.rem>Retreats all drones after this effect ends.</>
